blurb: A dwarf soldier turned sellsword. Tough as an anvil, straightforward, hard to knock down.

input.description: Stocky dwarf in dented chain mail, braided red beard-rings, dry sense of humour, fiercely loyal.

blurb: A halfling thief with quick fingers and quicker excuses. Best at sneaking, talking and stabbing first.

input.name: Wren Tealeaf
input.description: Small, freckled and grinning; wears a patched green cloak with far too many pockets.

blurb: An elf wizard who left the academy to see magic in the wild. Fragile, clever, and full of spells.
